title: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
abstract: Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. We study this question in pixel diffusion transformers and uncover two key insights. First, better representation quality does not necessarily translate into greater generative utility, as externally aligned semantics can be progressively lost during pixel synthesis. Second, architectural separation with specialized pixel decoders mainly redistributes semantic and spatial modeling, without necessarily yielding representations better suited to generation. These insights suggest that a useful generative representation must be both properly formed and actively exploited. Motivated by these insights, we introduce Representation Guidance (RG), which directly forms and exploits internal representations while retaining a plain Transformer architecture. A low-dimensional bottleneck forces generation-relevant information into a compact representation, which is then explicitly used to guide decoder generation by modifying the flow-matching target according to its induced prediction offset. RG learns clearer semantic and spatial structure while scaling efficiently in both parameters and computation. On ImageNet 256x256, RG-L/16 with only 459M parameters outperforms substantially larger pixel diffusion transformers, while RG-XL/16 achieves an FID of 1.55. RG further reaches an FID of 1.74 at 512x512 and extends to text-to-image generation, achieving 0.89 on GenEval and 87.1 on DPG-Bench.

summary.title_zh: 学习表征以引导像素扩散Transformer
summary.core_contribution: 论文揭示了表征质量与生成效用之间的非等价关系，并提出表征引导（Representation Guidance, RG）方法，通过在普通Transformer架构中直接形成并利用内部表征来提升像素扩散Transformer的生成性能。
summary.method: 作者在像素扩散Transformer中研究了视觉表征对生成的作用，发现外部对齐语义在像素合成过程中会逐渐丢失，且架构分离与专用像素解码器主要只是重新分配语义与空间建模。基于此，提出RG方法：通过低维瓶颈迫使生成相关信息压缩为紧凑表征，并根据其诱导的预测偏移修改流匹配目标，从而显式引导解码器生成，同时保持普通Transformer架构。
summary.findings: RG能学习更清晰的语义与空间结构，并在参数和计算上高效扩展。在ImageNet 256x256上，仅459M参数的RG-L/16优于更大的像素扩散Transformer，RG-XL/16达到FID 1.55；在512x512上FID为1.74；在文本到图像生成中，GenEval达到0.89，DPG-Bench达到87.1。

title: CoVA: Composing VAE Representations for Generative Learning
abstract: Representation alignment with pretrained visual encoders improves diffusion transformer training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own variational autoencoder (VAE). However, reconstruction-oriented VAE features are not optimized for the semantic discrimination and spatial structure needed for generative learning. We introduce \textbf{CoVA} (\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations), a lightweight framework that composes VAE features online into stage-wise guidance for flow-matching training. A small latent composer is jointly trained with class supervision, masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class posteriors. CoVA aligns intermediate SiT features with the composed representations early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with conditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoVA corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-dependent directional semantics. CoVA adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary parameters (1.3\% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, CoVA reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (\textbf{57\%}) in 400K steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of \textbf{2.03} in only 400 epochs, versus 2.06 after 1,400 epochs for vanilla SiT-XL/2.

summary.title_zh: CoVA：面向生成学习的VAE表示组合
summary.core_contribution: 提出CoVA框架，通过在线组合生成模型自身VAE的特征来为流匹配训练提供分阶段引导，无需辅助编码器即可显著提升扩散Transformer的生成质量，并揭示了软标签条件化中类别嵌入幅度衰减这一隐藏混杂因素。
summary.method: CoVA训练一个轻量级潜在组合器，将VAE特征在线组合为具有语义判别性和空间结构的密集特征，联合使用类别监督、掩码潜在重建和水平翻转一致性进行优化。训练早期将SiT中间特征与组合表示对齐，随后移除对齐并复用组合器的后验概率进行样本相关的软标签条件化。此外，CoVA通过恢复硬标签的幅度来纠正软标签条件化中类别嵌入平均化导致的幅度衰减问题，仅增加8.5M训练时辅助参数（占SiT-XL/2的1.3%），无推理时开销。
summary.findings: 在ImageNet 256×256上，CoVA将SiT-XL/2的FID从17.2降至7.4（降低57%），仅需400K步训练。配合无分类器引导，仅400个epoch即达到FID 2.03，而原始SiT-XL/2需1400个epoch才达到2.06。研究还发现，软标签条件化中类别嵌入平均化导致的幅度衰减本身就能大幅改善FID但会降低Recall，揭示了这一非语义来源的表观增益。

title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
abstract: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.

summary.title_zh: InstantFusion：面向异构图像生成器的共享潜在接口
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出了一种轻量级共享潜在接口InstantFusion，能够在无需为每对模型单独训练映射的情况下，连接异构扩散/流模型的去噪轨迹，实现跨模型状态转换与协同生成。
summary.method: 作者首先观察到独立训练的生成器在潜在空间组织上具有相似性，且未对齐模型间直接传递中间状态仍能保留粗略视觉内容。基于此，InstantFusion为每个模型引入特定的潜在自编码器（LAE），将不同生成器的中间状态投影到共享潜在空间，再解码到目标生成器的潜在空间。该共享空间通过两个互补目标约束：对齐同一图像在匹配噪声水平下的中间状态，并同步其对应的局部去噪速度。训练完成后，去噪过程可在冻结的生成器之间无缝切换。
summary.findings: InstantFusion在加速生成、多偏好组合、跨架构在线策略蒸馏以及跨模型组合等多种任务中均取得有竞争力的性能，验证了其通用性和有效性，表明异构生成器之间可以通过共享潜在接口实现灵活且高效的协同。

title: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
abstract: GUI grounding, the task of locating the interface element specified by a user instruction, is a fundamental capability of GUI agents. However, existing grounding models remain error-prone, often causing downstream task failures. We systematically evaluate 10 grounding models across five datasets and identify a major error pattern: most incorrect clicks hit non-target interface elements rather than the background, with different models repeatedly selecting the same distractors. Motivated by these findings, we propose ConClick, a contrastive learning framework that teaches models to distinguish the target element from plausible distractors. We construct ConClick-Data, a dataset containing 4,292 challenging target-distractor pairs, and train the model using complementary listwise ranking and pairwise margin objectives. ConClick improves the grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B from 54.71% to 66.03% on ScreenSpot-Pro, from 83.72% to 86.28% on MMBench-GUI L2, and from 63.33% to 70.20% on OSWorld-G, outperforming prior methods built on the same or similarly sized backbones. We further introduce ReClick, an inference-time strategy that revisits promising regions and compares predictions across competing candidates, yielding an additional 2.96 percentage-point improvement in average accuracy across the three benchmarks. Together, our analysis, dataset, and methods provide both empirical insights and practical tools for building more reliable GUI agents. Data and code are available at https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick.

summary.title_zh: ConClick：逐元素对比学习提升GUI定位能力
summary.core_contribution: 本文系统分析了GUI定位模型的错误模式，发现错误点击主要集中于非目标界面元素而非背景，并据此提出了对比学习框架ConClick及配套数据集ConClick-Data，显著提升了GUI定位准确率。
summary.method: 作者首先系统评估了10个定位模型在5个数据集上的表现，识别出模型反复选中相同干扰元素的错误模式。基于此，提出ConClick对比学习框架，构建了包含4,292个挑战性目标-干扰对的数据集ConClick-Data，并采用互补的列表排序和成对间隔目标训练模型。此外还提出ReClick推理时策略，通过重新审视候选区域并比较竞争候选的预测来进一步提升准确率。
summary.findings: ConClick将Qwen3-VL-8B在ScreenSpot-Pro上的定位准确率从54.71%提升至66.03%，在MMBench-GUI L2上从83.72%提升至86.28%，在OSWorld-G上从63.33%提升至70.20%，优于同等规模骨干网络的先前方法。ReClick推理策略在三个基准上进一步带来平均2.96个百分点的准确率提升。

title: TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation
abstract: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.

summary.title_zh: TextVBench：评估视频生成中的文本渲染与保持
summary.core_contribution: 提出了TextVBench，一个将视觉文本评估形式化为多目标、多实例时空对应问题的基准与评估框架，包含T2V和Ref2V两个互补赛道，用于衡量视频生成中文本的创建、维持与保持能力。
summary.method: 该框架采用目标条件化的候选选择策略，而非无约束的VLM转录，并支持一个目标映射到多个OCR区域。它将帧级空间保真度与跨帧时间保真度分离评估，使用长度加权调和分数汇总各项因素，并通过额外文本诊断揭示单一OCR分数所掩盖的失败模式。基准围绕受控的文本、布局、载体和运动属性进行组织，使总体分数可追溯到具体的能力限制。
summary.findings: 在评估的模型运行中，MiniMax-H3在T2V赛道取得68.32的TextVScore，而最强的Ref2V分数为56.51。属性切片分析显示，随着同时出现的参考文本区域数量增加，性能出现显著下降。
